summary: Inspected retained screenshots and measurement JSON at 1440, 1280, 1024, 768, 390 and 375 px. Fonts load at every width and the page sections stack without section-bound overflow; the fixed-width tab strip is intentionally contained by horizontal scrolling. The 375 px capture is nevertheless unhealthy with 14 px document overflow, and related-product cards/controls remain collapsed across responsive widths.
issues: RESP-PRODUCT-001 | priority high | property horizontal overflow at 375 px | expected: document overflow 0 and every page-owned control within x 0..375 | actual: overflow is 14 px; the first related-product Dodaj do koszyka control spans x 293.25..387.92 | fix: reflow or constrain the related-product card/control at the 375 px breakpoint.

RESP-PRODUCT-002 | priority high | property responsive related-card usability | expected: readable, consistently sized related-product cards and cart controls at 768, 390 and 375 px | actual: product-name columns are only about 79.6 px at 768 and 44.4 px at 390/375, cards are staggered vertically and CTA labels wrap into tall narrow blocks | fix: apply the intended WooCommerce card grid/selectors and a mobile layout that gives each card and CTA usable width.
